concerns.text: Phase 8 (Tasks T048–T052) introduces game-theoretic concepts (Nash Equilibrium, Minimax-Optimal Response, Utility Functions) that are absent from spec.md and plan.md. There is no FR/SC or plan element authorizing these tasks. This creates unanchored work that contradicts FR-006 (associational framing only).

Task T028 requires verifying 'p-value < 0.05 for at least 2/3 of the sweep points' and reporting pass/fail. While SC-002 defines this stability metric, there is no explicit task to generate the *report table* showing the sweep results (coefficients/p-values) which is required to perform the verification. T028 assumes the data exists but doesn't explicitly task the generation of the sensitivity analysis table itself, only the verification logic.

Task T025 ('Ensure all output reports frame findings as associational') is vague and lacks a specific output artifact or file path. FR-006 requires this framing in the 'final report', but T025 does not explicitly link to the report generation task (T030) or specify where this framing is implemented (e.g., 'Update docs/reports/final_analysis.md template').

Task T048 references a 'John von Neumann (simulated)' review concern. This specific reviewer persona/concern does not exist in the provided spec.md, plan.md, or analyze report. This is a stale or hallucinated tag referencing a non-existent requirement/element.

Task T029 is listed in the 'REJECTED' section of the comments but appears in the task list as 'missing an E-value calculation'. The spec.md and plan.md do not require E-value calculation (it was added in Complexity Tracking but not as a formal FR/SC). Tagging a task as 'missing' for a requirement that doesn't exist in the spec creates a false dependency.
